e: A Harbin Z-9 of the Armed Forces of Equatorial Guinea crashes into a mountain range between Niefang and Evinayong, killing all four occupants.
Prime minister Manuel Osa Nsue Nsua submits the collective resignation of the Council of Ministers and of the government, after failing to meet its performance targets.

A group of human rights lawyers and organizations file a case against Equatorial Guinea before the African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights for the forced repatriation of migrants deported from the US.
Pope Leo XIV visits Equatorial Guinea.
Cameroon and Equatorial Guinea sign an agreement to jointly extract natural gas from the Yoyo-Yolanda field.
Equatorial Guinea officially announces that its capital city will change from Malabo to Ciudad de la Paz.
